capabilities: Sync notes across devices over LAN with character-level CRDT merging
Pair devices with a QR code or shared sync key
Sync attachments by content hash with chunked streaming
Restore deleted or replaced files from the recovery center
Limit a device to syncing a single folder
extras: Free and open source; LAN-only, no internet sync. Phones cannot accept connections, so at least one desktop Obsidian must be online. Version history, logs and diagnostics live in .lan-vault-sync/.
problem: Keeping a vault up to date across devices without routing edits through a cloud server or account, and without losing edits made offline at the same time.
summary: Peer-to-peer vault sync over the local network using Yjs CRDT, with encrypted connections, attachment syncing and version history.
